rib_spacing = 10.0

solid_body = Box(leaf_length, leaf_width, leaf_thickness)

    (-leaf_length/2 + mount_hole_offset, 0),
    (leaf_length/2 - mount_hole_offset, 0)
]

    rib = Pos(x, 0, -leaf_thickness/2 + rib_height/2) * Box(rib_width, leaf_width - 2*mount_hole_offset, rib_height)
    solid_body = solid_body + rib

result = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

    (plate_length/2 - notch_width/2, plate_width/2 - notch_depth/2),
    (-plate_length/2 + notch_width/2, plate_width/2 - notch_depth/2),
    (plate_length/2 - notch_width/2, -plate_width/2 + notch_depth/2),
    (-plate_length/2 + notch_width/2, -plate_width/2 + notch_depth/2),
]

result = result - Pos(0, 0, boss_height/2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + boss_height)
